uncited: **Geometry:** Parameterized as a Signed Distance Field (SDF) $S$.
The method optimizes $S$, $k_d$, $k_{orm}$, and $L$ by minimizing a total loss function.
The 2D diffusion prior model trained on BlenderVault data to predict albedo and ORM from RGB images.
It serves as the source of the SDS guidance. [Link](8117-diffusion-based-guidance-for-radiance-field-optimization.md)
The differentiable renderer used to render geometry, materials, and lighting.
It provides the foundation for the inverse rendering pipeline. [Link](8117-diffusion-based-guidance-for-radiance-field-optimization.md)
The method used to extract the mesh $G$ from the SDF $S$ during optimization. [Link](8117-diffusion-based-guidance-for-radiance-field-optimization.md)
